context: A doctor explains lab measurements to a uni student
purpose: Teach: 実用/センチ/未満/ヵ月/インチ/記号/満載/ポンド

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 今日は健康診断の結果を一緒に見ていきましょう。情報満載の冊子なので、要点だけ説明しますね。
lines.en: Today let's go over your health check results together. The booklet is packed full of information, so I'll only explain the key points.
lines.style: Calm, professional doctor speaking gently to a young patient.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。正直、専門的な記号ばかりで全然読めなくて、不安なんです。
lines.en: Thank you. Honestly, it's all specialized symbols and I can't read it at all, so I'm anxious.
lines.style: Nervous university student, polite but visibly worried about results.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 大丈夫ですよ。まず身長と体重ですが、半年で二センチ伸びて、体重もきちんと増えていますね。
lines.en: It's alright. First, regarding height and weight, you've grown two centimeters in half a year, and your weight has properly increased as well.
lines.style: Reassuring tone, presenting concrete measurements in plain terms.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: アメリカ留学中の友達が、自分の体重をポンドで、身長をインチで言うんですよ。全然ピンと来なくて。
lines.en: A friend studying in America tells me their weight in pounds and their height in inches. I just can't picture it at all.
lines.style: Curious student sharing a relatable anecdote about foreign units.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ああ、日本ではメートル法が実用的ですからね。海外の単位は医学論文以外ではあまり使いません。
lines.en: Ah, in Japan the metric system is the practical one. Foreign units aren't really used outside of medical papers.
lines.style: Friendly explanation acknowledging cultural difference in measurement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。それで、悪い数値はありましたか?
lines.en: I see. So, were there any bad values?
lines.style: Direct follow-up question, leaning forward with concern.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 鉄分がわずかに基準値未満でした。ここ数ヵ月の食生活が偏っていた可能性がありますね。
lines.en: Your iron level was slightly below the reference value. Your diet over the past few months may have been a bit unbalanced.
lines.style: Delivering mild concern with a medically appropriate explanation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: よかった。要約すると、食事のバランスを整えれば大丈夫ということですね。
lines.en: What a relief. To summarize, if I balance my meals, I'll be fine, right?
lines.style: Relieved student confirming understanding by paraphrasing the doctor.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: その通りです。三ヵ月後にまた検査しましょう。お大事に。
lines.en: Exactly. Let's run the tests again in three months. Take care.
lines.style: Warm, natural closing remark scheduling appropriate follow-up care.
